title: The Flat Country Where Dreaming Sleeps

features.name: geometry-pressed-into-grass
features.desc-on-touch: you walk the paddock in the morning and the grass holds the trace of a shape that was dreamed the night before—a spiral, a path, a name written in flattened stalks

features.name: the-sleeping-horizon
features.desc-on-touch: where the flatland meets the sky so gently that there is no real line—just a place where the dreaming refuses to stop and the waking world becomes continuous with it

features.name: posts-that-mark-the-geometry
features.desc-on-touch: weathered fence posts driven into the earth in patterns only the dreaming paddock understands; they are the archive's attempt to record what shapes the grass takes

features.name: uniform-peace-breaking
features.desc-on-touch: a single tree stands alone in the flatness, and around it the dreams begin to multiply and contradict; one geometry becomes many

features.name: the-flattest-place
features.desc-on-touch: here the dreaming becomes so uniform that it is almost restful; the paddock and the sleeper agree on exactly the same shape

inscription: flatness and sleep discovered they were the same thing and agreed to keep dreaming in unison forever

file.name: Paddock_Geometry_Morning_Survey_Log_Six_Weeks.txt
file.note: morning measurements of grass patterns and overnight movements; the geometry always changes but never in a way that contradicts what the flatland needs

exits.label: back up the slope to where dreaming still argues with waking
the continuing flatness, where the dream extends beyond what any single paddock can hold
the slope down to a creek where the flatland starts to ripple
